prompt: Create one polished Chinese editorial infographic for a neutral technical knowledge base, landscape 1536x1024. verification: 中文、循环箭头与顺序已目视核对；图中图表为示意，无实际业绩。

prompt: Create a precise Chinese technical infographic landscape 1536x1024 for API integration. Off-white background navy text, teal normal path, orange exception path, crisp flat cards, generous space. Title 平台与厂商的交易请求. Two vertical lanes with large headers 厂商 on left and 平台 on right. verification: 中文与箭头已目视核对；步骤表达业务先后，记账与结果持久化的原子范围须按正文定义。

prompt: Create a precise neutral Chinese state-transition infographic, landscape 1536x1024, off-white navy teal and pale orange flat technical diagram, ample space, large short labels.
